To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the SML and SMC spectral minutiae representations improve the recognition accuracy of a minutiae-based fingerprint recognition system by about 2–5 times, (2) the SMC representation is the best choice, as it achieves the highest accuracy and it is also invariant to translation and scaling and (3) a template size reduction of 90% can be achieved by using the Line-DFT and the Column-PCA algorithms.

the complex spectral minutia representation (SMC) is a novel representation of a minutiae set that improves the accuracy of minutiae-based fingerprint recognition systems and that the Column-PCA feature reduction and the Line-DCT feature reduction are two feature reduction methods that achieve a template size of 10–15% and a matching speed of 100,000–125,000 comparisons/s.

the SMC spectral representation of minutiae sets improves the recognition accuracy of fingerprint recognition systems and that it enables template protection schemes to be combined with fingerprint recognition systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an efficient minutiae representation for combining fingerprint recognition systems with cryptographic template protection schemes.
the combination of fingerprint matching and template protection, and it is based on a new minutiae representation.
the development of a minutiae representation, which can be used to combine fingerprint recognition with template-protection schemes, and which can achieve fast matching.

SMC is the best representation for minutiae-based fingerprint recognition.
the SMC representation is the most promising for template protection schemes, and the Line-DCT and Line-DFT feature reduction are the most promising for fast minutiae matching.
SMC is the best choice for the combination of fingerprint matching with template protection schemes.

the SMC representation is the most robust representation for fingerprint recognition and it can be combined with template protection schemes.
we present a spectral minutiae representation that is more accurate than the location-based and orientation-based spectral minutia representations.

the complex spectral minutia representation is an accurate, fast, and robust feature representation, which is suitable for combining fingerprint recognition systems with cryptographic template protection schemes.
